lines.junior: I bring water here. I'm the one who wrote the note.
lines.master: I carry water for the builders. The note was mine.

lines.rookie: Your water drop is just like Seok's, in 1592.
lines.junior: Your water drop looks just like Seok's, from 1592.
lines.master: Your water drop is the very image of Seok's, from 1592.

lines.rookie: Seok? My mother told me that name.
lines.junior: Seok? My mother told me about that name.
lines.master: Seok? My mother spoke that name to me.
